selection.selection_method: Before new searches: earliest unique row by sorted relative file path then line, in setup/recovery/voluntary-switch/forced-replacement/Tera/Protect-available priority; fill to seven actual rows with earliest remaining rows, then append the pre-existing turn-2 fixture.

interpretation: Counterfactual choices using the same saved request/state, real priors, reset beliefs and seed per backend. Historical soft evidence and worker history are discarded; these are not exact reproductions of recorded decisions. Native visit shares are search support, not win probabilities. No rollout outcomes were measured here, so disagreement does not establish which action was stronger.
load_overlap: Sequential offline analysis overlapped the main four-concurrent-game pilot; these timings are diagnostics under shared load, not isolated latency benchmarks. The start/end window allows pilot latency contention to be identified.
